subject: SOC 2 re-attestation + private deployment onramp for renewal
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, procure@greenfieldhealth.com
Cc: audits@us-auditco.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention ask for upcoming renewal

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you're well. Greenfield's annual renewal is coming up (contract anniversary 2027-10-21) and our compliance team needs to confirm Redwood's SOC 2 re-attestation timeline and a few retention/hosting changes that are part of our renewal negotiations. High level: we are planning to expand usage (seat count from 10 to 25) and also want to run a private deployment in our AWS account behind our VPC for a subset of production traffic.

Specific requests from our side:
- Confirmation of Redwood's SOC 2 re-attestation date and whether we can get a copy of the updated report prior to renewal.
- Evidence bundle: system/config screenshots, control descriptions, sample audit logs for the last 90 days (currently Redwood provides 30 days). We need an estimate of what it takes to provide 90-day log retention as part of the commercial agreement.
- Proposed timeline for a private deployment onramp (pilot canary for 10% of traffic) and an estimate for seat-based pricing and any dedicated capacity fees.
- Contract amendment template covering retention, private deployment, and seat uplift (procurement will need that to complete our internal approval).

Can you please point me to the timeline and next steps? Our procurement lead (procure@greenfieldhealth.com) is on the thread. We have an external auditor (audits@us-auditco.com) who will validate evidence; they may request additional artifacts.

Thanks,
Sofia Martinez
Sr. IT Vendor Risk Manager
Greenfield Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@greenfieldhealth.com>, procure@greenfieldhealth.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention ask for upcoming renewal

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear summary. We're glad to support Greenfield's renewal and the planned expansion. Quick answers up front and proposed next steps below.

Short answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood's re-attestation is scheduled for 2027-11-12. We can provide a preliminary control summary and a provisional evidence bundle within two weeks; the final attestation report is typically available ~2-3 weeks after auditor sign-off.
- 90-day logs: we can provide a scoped 90-day audit log retention option; this is a commercial amendment (retention storage + ingestion pipeline).
- Private onramp: we can run a 2-week canary in your VPC for the initially nominated workloads, then expand. We'll need an onboarding checklist and security review.
- Pricing/contract: I'll circulate a draft amendment and a seat-based uplift estimate. Marissa will follow up with the commercial terms and DocuSign link.

Requested next steps (action owners):
1) Jordan Blake (security): confirm evidence bundle contents we can share and whether we need any redaction for vendor/audit sharing. Aim: evidence index in 5 business days.
2) Ben Carter (solutions): scope the technical plan and estimate for 90-day log retention + private VPC ingress/egress costs. Aim: cost estimate in 4 business days.
3) Marissa Cole (account lead): prepare the commercial amendment (inc. seat uplift to 25 seats, retention SLA, onramp timing) and DocuSign link. Aim: draft in 3 business days.

Attachments I'm sending in parallel: a list of the types of artifacts auditors typically ask for (soc2_evidence_index.xlsx) and a proposed retention matrix (retention_matrix_v2.pdf). I'll attach the amendment draft once Marissa and I have it aligned.

Sofia — is your compliance auditor available for a 30-minute kickoff next Thursday (2027-09-16) at 10:00 PT? If that works I'll get Jordan to join.

Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 11:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention ask for upcoming renewal — internal kickoff and tasks

Team — forwarding Greenfield's note. High level: renewal in ~6 weeks, auditor involved, client wants 90-day retention + private VPC onramp and seat uplift to 25. Commercials are likely to include a small monthly retention fee + one-time private deployment onboarding.

Action items (please reply with ETA):
- Jordan: assemble a shareable evidence index (use the attached soc2_evidence_index.xlsx as template). Flag anything that requires redaction or PM/Legal sign-off. Also confirm whether we can provide 90-day sample logs for the auditor and what format (S3 export, compressed JSON, etc.).
- Ben: estimate engineering work and infra delta for 90-day retention (storage, ingestion, query costs) and the private onramp (canary architecture, monitoring hooks, KV cache considerations). Provide a rough $ delta and whether we should propose a dedicated capacity pool.
- Marissa: draft amendment including retention, seat uplift to 25 seats, renewal term options (12 vs 24 months), and proposed SLA. Include DocuSign placeholder and an optional amortized onboarding fee.

Timeline: we have a kickoff call with Greenfield and their auditor on 2027-09-16 10:00 PT. We need to have the evidence index and a commercial draft before that call so Greenfield can present to procurement.

Notes and context: Greenfield is moving some sensitive PHI-related workloads into the private deployment, so expect tighter access control requests. Jordan — you'll need to surface any objections early. Ben — focus on how caching and batching choices affect cost at 25 seats and their anticipated throughput (~60 qps at peak).

I'll collect everyone's inputs and send a consolidated packet to Sofia + audits@us-auditco.com ahead of the 9/16 call.

—Kim

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@greenfieldhealth.com>, procure@greenfieldhealth.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Audits Team <audits@us-auditco.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention ask for upcoming renewal — draft evidence packet and amendment link

Sofia — quick update following our internal alignment. Attached: amendment_draft_Greenfield_2027.docx (contract language for 90-day retention, private VPC onramp, and seat uplift) and a partial evidence bundle (see soc2_evidence_index.xlsx for list).

Summary of what we've prepared:
- Evidence: Jordan has compiled an index and we can deliver a limited set of 90-day logs as compressed S3 exports for auditor review. Any PII/PHI will be redacted before transfer; the auditor will get an access grant window.
- Retention: proposed commercial option adds a monthly retention fee (see amendment) and includes the ingestion and storage delta. Ben's infra estimate: additional $2.4k/month for retained storage and query ops at projected throughput; dedicated capacity (optional) is a one-time onboarding + $3.5k/month reserved pool for the requested SLA.
- Private onramp: proposed schedule: 2-week canary starting 2027-10-03, then expand after sign-off. Canary will be limited to 10% traffic routed by your edge config to the VPC endpoints.
- Contract: Marissa has uploaded the amendment draft and created a DocuSign envelope for signature. DocuSign link: https://docusign.example.com/embedded-sign?envelopeId=abc123

Requested next steps for Greenfield:
1) Procurement: confirm whether Greenfield will sign the amendment (DocuSign) by 2027-09-24 to meet the planned canary start.
2) Auditor: if the auditor needs additional artifacts, please list them after reviewing the evidence index; Jordan will provide time-bound access to S3 exports.
3) Technical: if you want any changes to the onramp architecture (e.g., deeper network isolation vs private endpoints), let Ben know; we'll adjust the scope and cost.

Attached file list:
- soc2_evidence_index.xlsx (index of artifacts; redaction flags are marked)
- retention_matrix_v2.pdf (proposed retention tiers and cost delta)
- amendment_draft_Greenfield_2027.docx (draft contract amendment)

If procurement signs by 9/24, we can commit to the 2027-10-03 canary window and deliver the preliminary evidence bundle before your renewal date. Happy to jump on a short call if you want to walk through the amendment.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
